PLAN "12-Week General Strength - Spine-Safe Full Gym"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general full-body strength without loaded spinal flexion or heavy axial loading"
  GOAL secondary conditioning:
    name "Improve aerobic base and postural endurance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
